_comment: R-5 blast radius: a plan Work row that touches a shared_globs pattern requires a Verification row containing full_suite_command.
Selection criterion: a module is shared when it is imported by >= 2 other mechanisms (scripts, hooks, skill scripts), measured by grep of import lines on commit 4942828.

Measured importer counts: scripts/_root.py 27, scripts/_mode.py 11, scripts/_md_table.py 4, hooks/telemetry.py 3, hooks/state_mirror.py 3, scripts/_repro_grammar.py 2, hooks/on_commit.py 2 (hooks/on_commit_msg.py, scripts/upstream_outbox.py).
scripts/merge_json.py and scripts/install.py have 1 importer each and are not listed.
A host replaces this file wholesale with <host-root>/.agents-blast-radius.json; the two files are never merged.
